content: Sol Nuwana Deibid Ni Lopaaliga
Sauga etega Sol i baek wana totuwalali gegewel ge natuna Diyontan elal Deibid nihi lopaaliga. Yaa Diyontan i yaliyaya nabi Deibid kaiwena,
yaka i baek elana i ba, “Nam Sol kamwasa i loya ge ni lopaaligawa. He nu matahikagiwa, bwaligumwa mweluluga nu na uleya abamina etega nu kite inoke nu bunsumiya to.
Na ba nam elana, yaka naha nowa labi o elana ge na baaba kaiwem. Yaka ebo ga ni ba ola abwe wam wasa na pewa.”

Lan i gan mweluluga, alona tamana hi na uleya, inoke Diyontan Deibid i awa wawaisi-an tamana elana, yaka abwe i ba, “Bahi nak etega nu giginol wam totuwalali Deibid elana. Iya nige sauga etega nak i giginol eliyam. Bugul gegewena bolo i ginolil am labe kaiwena.

Nige i nuwanuwatu yawalina kaiwena yaka i na alona Golaiya gagama Pilistiya hi lohaveyan ge abwe i lopaaliga. Inoke Yehoba Isileli gegewela i pwamwalilaem nak bwabwatana elana, yaka owa u kite ge u yaliyaya. Deibid iya tau sasapona, inoke ga i ola nak nu ginol elana ge nu lopaaliga bwabwage?”
Sol Diyontan wana baaba i yaliyaya-an, yaka i ba, “Ya papasila Yehoba yawalina gaganina alanaa nige Deibid na lolopaaliga.”
Yaka abwe Diyontan Deibid i yogaan ge bugul gegewena bolo alona ge tamana hi liwanan i wasaan elana. Inoke i en pwatanik Sol elana, yaka i totuwalali al elana i ola valila.
Sauga etega Isileli avaliyau ge Pilistiya hi lohaveyan, yaka Deibid wana tolohaveyan i nulil hi na hi haveyan elal. Hi lohaveyan gagasisi yaka Pilistiya hi lou.
He lan etega Sol i misiyo wana limi gamwanaa wana gau i pihikan nimanaa. Yaka yayaluwa toapapanak toto i noem Yehoba elana wana gasisi i masal Sol elana. He Deibid iyoho wana hapi i lolol,
inoke Sol gau i alihin elana tage ginebi baba ni howa toyawel, yaa Deibid i kileyan inoke gau baba i howa. Yaka bulin o Deibid i lou.

Sol bolau enuna i patunal hi na Deibid wana limi hi kite hikan ana siga lan ni gan mweluluga, yaka nihi lopaaliga. Yaa Mikal, Deibid lagona, i baek elana i ba, “Ebo bulin e nige nu lolou, yaka bwaligumwa mweluluga te nihi lopaaligawa.”
Inoke Mikal hihiu elana Deibid i pakuki lowan windo etega elana, yaka i lou.
Inoke Mikal gogoginol etega i ahe ge i pakenuwa Deibid wana abakenuwa, yaka kaliko kekeisi goti pupunona elana hi ginoliya i teli kokowanaa ge kama etega i ahe i pahabobu.
Sol bolau i patunal hi nok tage Deibid nihi lib, yaka Mikal i baek elal i ba, “Deibid i kasiyebwa, iyoho i kenukenu wana abakenuwa.”
Yaka bolau o hi na Sol wana wasa hi pek, inoke i patunal hi sikal Deibid nihi kite. He i baek elal i ba, “Nuku kalivai wana abakenuwa ge nuku pwatanim eliyau na lopaaliga.”
Yaa sauga hi tuk limi gamwanaa, gogoginol hi kite Deibid wana abakenuwa ginebi ge goti pupunoliya i minaa kokowanaa. Yaka hi na Sol wana wasa hi pek.

Inoke Sol Mikal i yogaan ge i neli i ba, “Hauna kaiwena u kakaweyau ge o huga gamagalina u palou ge i egon?” Tamana anana i lahe i ba, “I ba palovakunau te ebo nige na lalabe ge ni lolou, yaka ni lopaaligau.”
He sauga Deibid i lou, yaka i na Samuwela elana panuwa Lama ge bugul gegewena toto Sol i ginol elana i wasaan. Yaka alona hi egon hi na awan Naiyot ge hi miminaa to.
Gamagalau enuna Sol wana wasa hi pek hi ba, “Deibid iyoho awan Naiyot panuwa Lama.”

Yaka bolau enuna i patunal hi nok tage nihi lib. Yaa sauga hi vin, inoke Samuwela hi kite palopitau ali boda etega i houwaagil Yabowaine Yayaluwana wana gasisi elana hi wonawona ge hi sagasaga. Yaka Yabowaine Yayaluwana i lau bolau o elal inoke heliya al ge hi wonawona ge hi sagasaga.

Sauga Sol wasaliya i hago, yaka bolau enuna al i patunal hi nok, inoke heliya al ge Yabowaine Yayaluwana wana gasisi elana hi wonawona ge hi sagasaga. Yaka paetonina bolau enuna i patunal hi nok, yaa pagan maisena o i gan al eliyalil.

Mowamowasena, Sol totona i egon i nanawa panuwa Lama kaiwena. Sauga i na i vin wewel kenken bwabwatana etega elana panuwa Seku, inoke gamagaliliyau i nelil i ba, “Samuwela alona ge Deibid ga hi miminaa?” Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Heliya iyoho panuwa Lama awanina Naiyot.”
Iya iyoho kamwasaa i nanawa Naiyot kaiwena, yaka Yabowaine Yayaluwana i lau elana inoke i nonowonawona ge i nonosagasaga ana siga i na i vin awan Naiyot.

Inoke ana kaliko enuna i palo yohil tuwana i pabokaboka, yaka i wonawona ge i sagasaga Samuwela manininaa. Yaka i tal kenu bilibiliya, inoke lan ge bulin bwabwaligena i kenukenu i ola to. Pagan o i gan elana, yaka gamagalau wali baaba etega hi babaa, “Bi ola ge Sol iya al palopita avaliya etega?”
